routes.title: Chasing Cuccos in Kakariko Village
routes.description:
This route will help you find all seven runaway cuccos for the Cucco Lady in Kakariko Village!

Find the seven hidden Cucco scattered about, pick them up, and place them in the pen near the Cucco Lady!

properties.instruction: Talk to the Cucco Lady outside of her presently empty Cucco enclosure along the southwestern edge of Kakariko Village and agree to help her find her missing Cuccos to start this side quest!
Find this Cucco near the construction site - it doesn't move, but it's near a wooden scaffolding.
On a pile of bricks to the east of the Cucco Lady. Either grab a Cucco and glide over to reach it or, more expediently, just shoot it with your Fairy Slingshot to knock it down!
This Cucco can be found wandering around northwest of the Cucco Lady, between the entrance to the village and the large tree.
This silly bird has gotten itself trapped in a box. Destroy the box to free it.
Along the northern exit to the village, wandering out in the open.

properties.title: Cucco Glide Spot
properties.instruction: Grab a Cucco and head to a ledge below the windmill, then jump north over a fence - the Cucco will allow Link to glide over the fence!

A Cucco hidden behind the otherwise inaccessible fenced-in area along the northeastern edge of the village. Grab it, go up the nearby stairs, and toss it over the fence to the main part of the village.
A Cucco roaming about the otherwise inaccessible northeastern edge of the village. Toss it down to the lower, more easily-reached part of the village.

properties.title: Quest Reward: Empty Bottle
properties.instruction: Find all seven Cucco and place them back in their pen, then talk to the Cucco Lady to obtain an Empty Bottle as a reward!

routes.title: Dancing Vessel Piece of Heart
routes.description: This route will help you get the Piece of Heart from the Dancing Vessel in Goron City!

properties.title: Get the Bomb Bag
properties.instruction: You'll need Bombs for this puzzle, so get the Bomb Bag from Dodongo Cavern!

properties.title: Light a Deku Stick
properties.instruction: Use the lit torch in Darunia's chamber to ignite a Deku Stick.

properties.title: Light Torches
properties.instruction: Use your burning Deku Stick to light four torches in the chamber to the south of Darunia's chamber.

properties.title: Dancing Vessel
properties.instruction: This will cause the Dancing Vessel to start spinning!

properties.title: Bomb-Throwing Spot
properties.instruction: Head up a level to the bomb-throwing spot - a wooden platform you can use to gain the distance required to throw bombs into the Dancing Vessel!
Chuck a bomb into the Dancing Vessel and it'll cough up a Piece of Heart and some Rupees!

routes.title: Goron Bracelet and Opening Dodongo Cavern
routes.description: This route will guide you through the process of obtaining the Goron Bracelet and opening the way to the Dodongo Cavern dungeon!

properties.title: Play Zelda's Lullaby
properties.instruction: Play Zelda’s Lullaby outside of the door to "Darunia" iconDarunia’s chamber.

properties.title: Learn Saira's Song
properties.instruction: If you didn't learn Saira's Song already, learn it by meeting with her in the Sacred Grove.

properties.title: Play Saria's Song
properties.instruction: Placate Darunia by playing Saira’s Song nearby.
Darunia, now calmed down a bit, will give you the Goron Bracelet, allowing you to pick up Bomb Flowers!

properties.title: Throw the Bomb Flower
properties.instruction: Throw the Bomb Flower over the fence to blast open the entrance to the Dodonga Cavern dungeon!

routes.title: Happy Mask Shopkeeper
routes.description: This route will help you start and complete the Happy Mask Shopkeeper quest, which can be started and completed all as Young Link. Not only will you get some decent Rupees out of it, but you'll also unlock the Mask of Truth.

properties.instruction:
The Happy Mask Shop is located in Hyrule Castle Town, but it isn't open right away on your first visit. You'll have to wait until you open the gate to Death Mountain, which requires showing the guard in Kakariko Village Zelda's Letter.

The Happy Mask Shop works by you borrowing a mask, finding its respective buyer, then selling it. Each mask has a value attached to it, so once you sell it, return to the shop and pay the owner what it's worth.

properties.title: Keaton Mask
properties.instruction: The first mask you will be borrowing is the Keaton Mask. The person who wants this mask is the one Hyrule Guard that was guarding the gate leading to Death Mountain, in Kakariko Village. Head there, equip the mask from the in-game menu, then speak to the guard to have him offer to purchase the mask for you. He will give you 15 Rupees, so return to the shop and hand over 10 Rupees for the mask.

properties.title: Skull Mask
properties.instruction: The second mask is the Skull Mask, which will have you taking a trip to Lost Woods. Go to Kokiri Forest and enter the Lost Woods from there. As soon as you enter, take the first left and you will see a Skull Kid on top of a tree. This is the one you need, so equip the mask and talk to him to have the Skull Kid purchase the mask for 10 Rupees. Return to the Mask Shop to hand over 20 Rupees (so you're losing 10), then it's time for the third mask.

properties.title: Spooky Mask
properties.instruction: The third mask is the Spooky Mask, which will cost you 30 Rupees once you return to the shop. You will have to go to the Graveyard in Kakariko Village for this one, but it will need to be daytime since the kid isn't out at night. Approach him with the mask equipped, then talk to him to have him purchase the Spooky Mask for 50 Rupees. Return to the Mask Shop, pay the 30 Rupees and it's time for the final step.

properties.title: Bunny Hood
properties.instruction:
The final step to this quest will have you find someone who wants the Bunny Hood. You may have to wait until you get all three Spiritual Stones first, but the NPC who wants this is the Running Man. He will be roaming Hyrule Field, so it might be difficult to pinpoint his exact location.

Despite that, going into Castle Town, play the Sun's Song to make it daytime, then exit to Hyrule Field. The Running Man should be straight ahead of you usually going west. Catch up to him, speak to him with the Bunny Hood equipped and he'll fork over 200 Rupees for it. Bring this back to the Mask Shop and you'll finish up this quest, unlocking the Goron Mask, Zora Mask, Gerudo Mask, and the Mask of Truth. The first three don't do anything, but the last one lets you get unique dialog with NPCs, as well as speak to the Gossip Stones all around Hyrule.

routes.title: Saria's Song
routes.description: Follow this route to navigate the Lost Woods and learn Saira's Song in the Sacred Grove!

properties.title: Lost Woods Entrance - Kokiri Forest
properties.instruction: Enter the Lost Woods via the transition along the northern edge of the Kokiri Forest.

properties.title: Follow Saria's Song to the Sacred Grove
properties.instruction: From the entrance to the Lost Woods from Kokiri Village, follow the sounds of the ocarina to reach the Sacred Grove: Take the exits to the right, left, right, left, forward, left and right.

properties.title: Defeat the Wolfos
properties.instruction: Defeat the Wolfos to open the gate to the Sacred Grove!

properties.title: Defeat the Mad Scrubs
properties.instruction: Defeat the Mad Scrubs in the maze leading up to the northern edge of the Sacred Grove!

properties.title: Learn Saira's Song
properties.instruction: Talk to Saria along the northern edge of the Sacred Grove and repeat her song to learn Saria's Song!

routes.title: Sneaking into Hyrule Castle
routes.description: This route will guide you through the castle grounds and help you sneak your way into Hyrule Castle!

properties.instruction: Talk to Malon and she'll give you a Weird Egg, which you need to rouse her father, Talon.
Climb some vines to reach a platform above the road.
Climb a second set of vines to reach the top of the first gate.

properties.title: Wake-Up Cucco Hatch
properties.instruction: Eventually the Weird Egg should hatch into a Wake-Up Cucco. When this happens is random - enough time has to have elapsed, so it could occur at various points during this route!

properties.title: Hiding Spot
properties.instruction: Get on the high ground left of the road and find a gap between the fence and the hedges you can sneak through.

properties.title: Hiding Spot
properties.instruction: Continue splitting the hedges, making sure you’re not in the line of sight of any guards!
Make your way to the western edge of the gardens outside the castle and find some vines you can climb on the northern wall.

properties.title: Jump into the Moat
properties.instruction: Jump into the moat, then swim east and north under the guarded bridge to find some stairs leading up to the side of the castle.

properties.title: Rouse Talon
properties.instruction: Use the Wake-Up Cucco on Talon to rouse him from his slumber!

properties.title: Push Crates
properties.instruction: Push the crates south and west to form a platform you can use to gain some height.

properties.title: Jump Over the Moat
properties.instruction: Jump off the crates to reach a drainage platform across the moat.

properties.title: Crawl into the Castle
properties.instruction: Crawl through a hole to get inside Hyrule Castle!

routes.title: Sun's Song
routes.description: This route will guide you through the steps required to obtain the Sun's Song melody, which allows you to change day into night and night into day on a whim!

properties.instruction: Interact with the southernmost tomb to summon Flat the Younger, then defeat the geist!
Examine Sharp's tomb to manifest Sharp the Elder, and beat him up! He'll provide more clues than his younger brother did.

properties.title: Play Zelda's Lullaby on the Triforce Symbol
properties.instruction: Stand on the Triforce symbol and play the Zelda's Lullaby after defeating the royal composer ghosts to open the Sun's Song tomb!

properties.title: Keese
properties.instruction: Shoot down some Keese (bats) with your Fairy Slingshot.

properties.title: ReDead
properties.instruction: Run past some ReDeads - give them a wide berth, as they're a bit tough to defeat in a head-on fight at this point in the game!

properties.title: Play the Sun's Song Melody
properties.instruction: Read the inscription and play the Sun's Song melody to obtain it!
